title: anthemis cretica var. subcinerea
intro: Anthemis cretica var. subcinerea, commonly known as Mountain Calendula, is a plant species in the daisy family. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help to soothe skin irritations and promote wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Mountain Calendula include its ability to calm and soothe irritated skin, reduce inflammation, and promote tissue repair. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, sesquiterpenes, and triterpenoids, which are believed to contribute to its medicinal properties.
